_comment: Little, one step down the size axis: half of what was tuned, where `minuscule` is a quarter. The
axis is geometric, so the five words -- minuscule, small, unsaid, large, colossal -- are equal steps.
No query, as `large` has none: the axis is what this word means, so the axis is all it sets.
